statement: A booking is not required to visit the Jetty Road Brewery taproom.
note: Deliberately authored with no evidence attached, which makes it unsupported. The operator site carries a book now link and says nothing about whether a booking is required, and nothing else retrievable on 2026-09-13 settled it. A false here is a positive assertion to a reader planning a Friday night, and it is asserted by this record alone. Authored by hand for the PI-005 Stage 2 venue pilot. Sources were read on 2026-09-13; see ops/reports/claims/2026-09-13-pilot-venues.md.
